en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Tsumugi grabbed my hand and dragged me
to the girls bathroom on the 1st floor.
A-Are you gonna punch me...or tie me up?

Hey, now...there's no way I'd do a thing 
like that.
Now hurry up and take your clothes off.
What!? Why!?

Well, because I'm going to cosplay as you, 
of course. Now give me your clothes.
Huh? But—
Come on, come on. Hurry up!
Whaaaat!?

<CLT=cltMIND>I slowly undressed and handed my clothes
to Tsumugi.

<CLT=cltMIND>After telling me to look the other way, I waited
while she changed into my clothes...
Okay, now you can look.

<CLT=cltMIND>A gross, bumpy rash had spread across
Tsumugi's body.
Hi...I'm Kaede Akamatsu...
A-Aaaaaaaaaaahhhhhhh!!!

This isn't cosplay of the spiky-headed 
underling of a certain space emperor...

This is cospox—an allergic reaction that 
happens when I dress up as real people.

This is the price for my power...
The equivalent exchange for my cosplay.

O-Okay! I get it!
Change out of my clothes already!

<CLT=cltMIND>We exchanged our clothes, then returned to the
library where Shuichi was waiting.
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?
Monitor
